name: Kirk Kapital
source_note: Official site says it manages and grows family-owned capital and takes strategic minority ownership in Scandinavian B2B companies; portfolio and active partnership described.

name: Axcel
source_note: Official page identifies Axcel as a Nordic private-equity firm and lists current portfolio companies and platform investments; Copenhagen address is listed.

name: Polaris
source_note: Official page says Polaris invests in majority equity positions and other investments in Nordic mid-sized companies; Copenhagen address is listed.

name: VIA equity
source_note: Official page describes a Copenhagen-founded private-equity firm that invests in and actively develops Northern European software and IT companies.

name: Capidea
source_note: Official site identifies Capidea as a private-equity fund and shows operating portfolio-company investments.

name: GRO Capital
source_note: Official site says GRO invests flexibly as a minority or majority partner in advanced B2B software companies; it is headquartered in Copenhagen.

name: Thominvest
source_note: Official site identifies Thominvest as a Helsinki-based family-owned investment company with a direct investment approach focused on building businesses.

name: Hartwall Capital
source_note: Official site describes a Finnish family-owned investment company, its portfolio holdings, and active ownership of Nordic companies.

name: Besodos Investors

name: Aspira

name: CapMan

name: Intera Partners
source_note: Official Intera document describes a Finnish growth-equity investor taking ownership stakes in Finnish and Swedish companies and developing its portfolio with management. Evidence document is dated 2017; recheck current mandate before matching.

name: Eyrir Invest
source_note: Official page identifies Eyrir as an international investment company following a buy-and-build strategy and investing directly in a small number of companies; company also self-identifies as a family office.

name: Alfa Framtak
source_note: Official page describes investments in Icelandic businesses and active ownership across traditional private equity, growth capital, and special situations.

name: Aars
source_note: Official page says Aars is a family office and investment company with direct-investment holdings and long-term active ownership across Nordic businesses.

name: Ferd
source_note: Official page describes direct equity investments in private companies and active ownership; Ferd identifies itself as a family-owned investment company.

name: Silversky Group
source_note: Official page describes a family-owned private investment office making direct investments, co-investments, and club deals; it publishes a portfolio.

name: Joya
source_note: Official page identifies Joya as an Oslo-based family office investing across public and private markets and lists companies where its capital is invested.

name: Investinor
source_note: Official mandate says Investinor directly invests in growth companies alongside private investors and exercises active ownership. State-owned investor, not a family office.

name: Norvestor
source_note: Official page describes Norvestor’s direct investments and active ownership in mid-sized Nordic businesses; it has an Oslo office.

name: FAM
source_note: Official page says FAM is a privately owned holding company owned by Wallenberg foundations and an active long-term owner of portfolio companies.

name: Kinnevik
source_note: Official site identifies Kinnevik as a growth investor and active owner investing in technology-enabled companies; its Stockholm address is listed.

name: Lundbergföretagen
source_note: Official page describes Lundbergs as an investment company investing in and actively developing its portfolio businesses and real estate over the long term.

name: EQT
source_note: Official page describes EQT Private Equity’s direct investments in companies; EQT lists its Stockholm office and current company portfolio.

name: Stena Sessan
source_note: Official site describes a flexible, long-term investment strategy and active co-ownership in portfolio companies; Stockholm office listed.

name: Investor AB
source_note: Official site says Investor was founded by the Wallenberg family and supports its global portfolio companies through long-term ownership and board participation; Stockholm office listed.

name: Altor
source_note: Official Altor report describes private-equity investments in private and public companies and lists Stockholm among its Nordic offices; country is based on documented Stockholm office, not exclusive Swedish focus.

name: Jacobs Capital
source_note: Investment page says it targets control or co-control investments in private companies and other businesses; its about page documents Zurich roots and Jacobs-family capital.

name: Partners Group
source_note: Official release says Partners Group agreed to acquire a majority stake in AVK Power Solutions and plans a direct equity investment of over USD 1 billion on behalf of clients.

name: Capvis
source_note: Official transaction release identifies Capvis as a Swiss private equity investor that primarily acquires majority stakes in mid-sized companies; it describes its investment in AdEx Partners.

name: Ufenau Capital Partners
source_note: Official current and realized portfolio page documents company investments and buy-and-build ownership; the firm describes majority investments and direct company development.

name: Verium
source_note: Official page identifies Verium as an active direct investor that invests its own capital in DACH companies through majority or significant minority stakes, and lists operating portfolio companies.

name: EGS Beteiligungen AG
source_note: Official site says EGSB is wholly owned by the Ernst Göhner Foundation and invests foundation assets in Swiss-related companies; it lists an operating-company portfolio.

name: Invision
source_note: Official investment-focus page describes succession solutions, MBO/MBI financing, active minority positions, growth financing, and its portfolio of operating businesses.

name: CGS Management
source_note: Official investor page says CGS invests in small and medium-sized companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland and develops them through industrial buy-and-build; it gives the Swiss address.

name: Helvetica Capital
source_note: Official portfolio page says it takes majority stakes in established Swiss industrial companies, assumes ownership responsibility, and lists active portfolio businesses.

name: Franz Haniel & Cie.
source_note: Official site describes Haniel as a long-term family-owned investor, focuses on majority stakes, and lists direct portfolio companies and acquisition history.

name: Deutsche Beteiligungs AG (DBAG)
source_note: Official fund page says DBAG Fund VIII invests directly in equity of mid-sized companies and lists current portfolio companies; DBAG also commits its own capital.

name: Mutares SE & Co. KGaA
source_note: Official company page says Mutares acquires portfolio companies, supports their operational transformation and value creation; its portfolio page lists operating businesses.

name: AUCTUS Capital Partners
source_note: Official investments page lists active portfolio companies and describes AUCTUS as having made over 470 company investments, with active buy-and-build ownership.

name: Deutsche Private Equity (DPE)
source_note: Official site says DPE funds invest in mid-sized growth companies as majority and minority shareholders and lists active portfolio companies and recent acquisitions.

name: Paragon Partners
source_note: Official site says it invests in established mid-sized companies, supports them as an active shareholder, and lists 14 portfolio companies.

name: Maxburg Capital Partners
source_note: Official portfolio page lists active operating-company investments and describes ownership transactions, including acquiring shares from previous owners alongside management.

name: AURELIUS
source_note: Official site describes AURELIUS's private equity platforms and hands-on operational support for investments; it publishes a portfolio of operating companies.

name: BU Bregal Unternehmerkapital
source_note: Official BU portfolio page identifies proALPHA as an active investment. BU's official site lists its Munich office; BU is a direct-investing mid-market private-equity firm across DACH and neighboring economies.

name: Stoðir
source_note: Official site describes Stoðir as a privately owned Icelandic investment company that invests in selected projects where it can take an active role; site documents a Reykjavík office.

name: Gyrus Capital
source_note: Geneva-based PE firm; official investment approach states buyouts with majority or significant minority control/governance rights and lists portfolio investments including Swiss-headquartered Neo Medical.

name: Patrimonium Private Equity
source_note: Swiss private-markets manager with offices in Baar, Zurich, and Lausanne; its PE page says it provides equity to mid-sized companies mainly in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland and uses targeted acquisitions.

name: Capital Transmission
source_note: Swiss PE investor with Geneva and Zurich offices, focused primarily on Switzerland; official page describes equity/quasi-equity for SME growth, succession, and buyout transactions, with portfolio investments in Swiss companies.

name: Porterhouse Group AG
source_note: Lucerne-based Swiss holding company; official site says it invests its own funds and seeks majority positions in operating companies, including Swiss portfolio companies.

name: F.G. Pfister
source_note: Swiss holding/investment company backed by the F.G. Pfister Foundation; official history documents nine Swiss SME holdings added through succession transactions since 2020 and a long-term ownership model.

name: Haute Capital Partners
source_note: Swiss-listed PE holding company; official site states it invests directly in selected private Swiss businesses and actively manages participations, with a current portfolio of non-listed companies.

name: CC Trust Group AG
source_note: Official site identifies CC Trust as a Switzerland-based family office that invests in and develops existing companies, acting as business owner/investor and listing a current portfolio of more than 15 investments.

name: PALOSANTO
source_note: Official site identifies PALOSANTO as a Geneva-headquartered single-family investment vehicle and active investor in companies; it states it can take majority or minority equity positions.

name: M&S Ventures Group
source_note: Official site describes a privately owned investment/holding group based in the Lake Geneva region that invests its own capital and holds controlling interests in Swiss companies.

name: Hu2 Capital Partners AG
source_note: Zurich-based investment company; its official site documents a 2022 full takeover of a manufacturer with operations in Switzerland and Germany, alongside other operating-company ventures.
